finding.summary: payPaymentLink in apps/api/src/paymentLinks/pay.ts re-claimed reservations older than PAYMENT_LINK_RESERVATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (60s) and did not bind finalize or releaseReservation to the claimant (a 0-row finalize still returned 200 'paid'), so a buyer whose authorize+capture outlasted the timeout lost the reservation to a second buyer and both captured, double-charging a single-use payment link (e.g. two captures of 128,450 fils, incident 2026-05-14).
